title: Cuba didn't organize your protests. The State Department says otherwise.
body: The State Department put out a 100-page report this week naming Cuba the "capital of 21st century communism" and blaming it for Black Lives Matter, the anti-ICE protests, and Antifa. It names names including The Democratic Socialists of America, Code Pink, LA Mayor Karen Bass, streamer Hasan Piker, all cast as witting or unwitting assets of Cuban intelligence. The Intercept reports it's the brainchild of Marco Rubio, who has made toppling Havana a personal project.

Two members of Congress just back from Cuba called it what it is. Rep. Delia Ramirez said the report was "intentionally designed to instill fear of the Cuban people and to justify a military attack on Cuba," while going after Americans' own rights to speak and protest. Rep. Mark Pocan called it "the stupidest, most fantastical, most biased thing I've ever read from a governmental agency." This is a country the US has choked with a fuel blockade since January, now in daily blackouts.

When a protest at home is inconvenient, it can't be Americans who are angry, it has to be a foreign hand. Blame Havana, and the crowd in the street becomes an enemy operation. It's an old script, and they're running it again while one war is still going badly.
